desc: Ideation and mathematical characterization of f and v2-sum decomposition.
Implement the O(25*N) exact-valuation residue-bucketing solution (single pass per k with count+sum buckets, diagonal correction) and verify it produces 5, 384, 20241214 on the three samples.
Write an independent brute force O(N^2) checker and run randomized small tests (N<=30, small and large values, duplicates, all-even/all-odd, N=1) against the implementation.
Confirm all 3 public samples PASS via the sample-test verdict.
Edge cases (N=1, all equal, all-even/all-odd, near 1e7) covered by random + hand checks; integer division/lossless-shift reasoning validated.
Constant-factor/performance review for N=2e5 (list buckets for small moduli, dict otherwise) deemed acceptable.
